sources.title: A Detailed Database of the Chemical Properties and Methane Potential of Biomasses Covering a Large Range of Common Agricultural Biogas Plant Feedstocks
reviewed_sections: Appendix A Table A1, pp209-210, six individual ENSI Grass rows (not Mix Grass)

conditions.reactor_type: 500 mL bottles, 300 mL charge, duplicate tests
conditions.inoculum: APESA, maintained at38 +/-1 C; inoculum/substrate3 gVS/gVS
conditions.storage: 5 C for <=3 days, otherwise -20 C and thawed at6 C
conditions.endpoint: Daily gas change below0.5% for three consecutive days
conditions.gas_reference_text: Normal liters at0 C and printed1.013 hPa. Pressure unit is ambiguous; no silent correction applied.

limitations: Grass rows are individual ENSI samples; exact harvest/ensiling state and packing density are not identified. State transfer is conditional, never a matched fresh-grass measurement.
DM and VS both percent fresh mass. Paired values retained per row.
BMP standard deviations refer to duplicate assays, not a population or prediction interval.
Normal pressure is printed with an ambiguous unit; numerical common-basis normalization requires an explicit assumption.
No universal grass density or actual reactor recovery is supplied.

profiles.state_transfer_note: ENSI grass sample; exact fresh/ensiled/preparation status not specified. Comparison to the requested state is a hypothetical transfer, not confirmed equivalence.
profiles.approved_scope: Individual paired grass sample; state and gas-reference transfer must be explicitly conditional
profiles.preparation: ENSI grass sample, cooled/frozen laboratory storage; harvest, ensiling and size preparation not specified per sample

bmp_ml_g_vs.original_unit: Nm3 CH4/t VS = mL CH4/g VS
bmp_ml_g_vs.spread_type: SD of duplicate assays; not prediction interval
